script.rule: Do not claim lyric-line timing, final shot timings or performance synchronization until independently verified against audio and the 50-shot storyboard.

batch_structure.original_still_policy: Preserve originals and SHA-256 provenance; canonical storyboard cells are direction references, not finished production stills. Never silently promote candidate stills or contact-sheet crops.

stages.purpose: Prepare source-preserving localized water, atmospheric, reflections and motivated practical-light motion; A/B variants for later composition.
stages.pass_rule: Light FX technical PASS requires actual rendered nonzero intended material movement, protected-ROI integrity, usable loop seam and verified hashes. Do not demand performer or articulated character movement at this gate.

stages.purpose: Compile convincing moving scenes and, where required, actual subject action from La Luna's protected source stills using the current-main reusable FX library, shot-derived duplicate/alternate image states, GIF and video loops, transparent layers, depth/2.5D, legitimate Gaussian effects and Director-authored camera movement/cuts. This is a per-shot layered animation/compositing gate, NOT an automatic video-generation requirement.
stages.pass_rule: The actual moving-shot proof must plausibly show the storyboard's required observable action from source-derived poses/layers, loops, approved FX and restrained Director camera work, while preserving protected face/hand/anatomy, instruments and scene geometry. If a dance step, guitar fingering or violin bow action is required, environmental warp, global camera/parallax motion, or lighting alone is not evidence of articulated performance. Mark PERFORMANCE_MOTION_GAP until real motion or approved bounded continuation exists. A non-performing/non-character shot may be NOT_APPLICABLE for subject articulation without blocking appropriate world/scene animation.

technologies_and_existing_library.gaussian_terms: 2D Gaussian fields for light, glow, blur and haze are image-space effects. True 3DGS/SuperSplat (FX2-SPATIAL-003) is conditional, and requires real geometry and verified project-specific preflight. Never claim a 2.5D depth-plane as 3DGS.
technologies_and_existing_library.source_and_effect_acceptance: An effect's registry status is only eligibility. Select by current La Luna scene semantics with current-main fx_resolver and verify actual implementation, rendered proof and precompile gate; never blanket-apply to every shot.

stages.purpose: Composite selected, inspected light and character passes with song, lyrics and script; direct cinematic pacing, motion continuity, grade and sound/image sync.
stages.pass_rule: Master FX synchronizes motion/edit events using the music evidence and independently verified lyric cues; reviews identity, performers, continuity, edit rhythm, complete source-audio integrity and actual final export.

handoff_and_approval.per_batch_decision_record: Record per-stage technical status, artistic review, source provenance, output hashes and Drive/archive locators separately for each batch; never combine Light FX PASS with Character FX or Master FX acceptance.
handoff_and_approval.source_isolation: Do not modify original stills, WAV, board or already archived A/B light FX proofs when making Character FX candidates.
handoff_and_approval.approval_scope: User approval of storyboard or FX process does not imply approval of every still, animated shot, complete film or release.

external_film_reference_boundary.permission: A separate movie project may be studied only after user identifies it; process_learning_only.
external_film_reference_boundary.promotion_rule: No automatic import of external project data, media or source code. The user explicitly authorized the shared method of duplicate-still/loop/GIF/Gaussian/depth/layer/FX/camera shot compile for La Luna; its concrete implementation must use current-main neutral verified capabilities, La Luna's own board/assets, gates, and independent QC. Any additional transfer of external implementation or project-specific behavior needs separate user approval.
external_film_reference_boundary.approved_method: source image duplicate/loop/GIF/layer/depth/FX library/camera compile is explicitly authorized as La Luna animation workflow, using existing CURRENT LAB MAIN primitives only

user_clarification_2026_10_15: Character animation is principally constructed/compiled using our existing FX library, duplicated/variant still images, GIF and loop motion, Gaussian family (truthfully distinguished), 2.5D/depth, Director shot cuts and camera movement—not assumed independent AI-generated video for every shot. Film-specific actor/instrument action must still be depicted convincingly.

reference_method_study.comparison_with_current_lab_main: exact matching core FX registry/runtime; Lab main adds resolver/execution/recipes
